state: Record Choice derives a nominal record from written inline options plus the declared fields of each arm-record spread, preserving their order and then appending explicit metadata. Spread values are evaluated at runtime, even when choosing among existing records. Name resolution installs the record/question pair in advance. Type construction currently precedes graph sealing, whereas full expression validation consumes sealed types. One proposed bridge reads only declared type evidence for value names, constructors, field selection, indexing, copy updates and callable return annotations to establish field names, followed by complete ordinary checking after sealing. Inconclusive or recursive shape discovery is an error, never guessed data. Compare that annotation projection against building a provisional complete graph, using the normal checker to derive spread shapes, and rebuilding a final graph; or refactoring the expression checker so its shape-only phase can run before sealing while full semantic checks still occur afterward. Every option must reject unresolved cycles, validate complete expressions, and avoid authored execution/provider calls.

shape.instructions: Choose the approach that respects nominal record completeness without executing source expressions.

criteria.project: Add a narrow declaration-evidence projection while leaving the sealed checker authoritative.
criteria.rebuild: Construct an initial graph for expression analysis and reconstruct the graph once spread fields are known.
criteria.refactor: Refactor ordinary expression typing into shape discovery before sealing and compatibility checks after sealing.
